content.text: {v.lost and (v.cmdIdx == 1 and '> Return' or '  Return') or (v.win and (v.cmdIdx == 1 and '> Return' or '  Return') or (v.cmdIdx == 1 and '> Move Left' or '  Move Left'))}
{v.lost and '' or (v.win and '' or (v.cmdIdx == 2 and '> Hold' or '  Hold'))}
{v.lost and '' or (v.win and '' or (v.cmdIdx == 3 and '> Move Right' or '  Move Right'))}

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.hp = 3
v.skeletons_left = 15
v.skeletons = {}
for y = 3, 5 do
    for x = 1, 5 do
        v.skeletons[x .. "_" .. y] = true
    end
end
v.ward_x = 3
v.bolt_x = 3
v.bolt_y = 2
v.bolt_dx = 1
v.bolt_dy = 1
v.cmdIdx = 2
v.log = {"Battle begins!", "Necromancer summoned Skeletons.", "Ricochet Bolt active."}
v.lost = false
v.win = false

local function updateDraw()
    local text = ""
    for y = 5, 1, -1 do
        local rowText = ""
        for x = 1, 5 do
            if x == v.bolt_x and y == v.bolt_y then
                rowText = rowText .. " O "
            elseif y >= 3 and v.skeletons[x .. "_" .. y] then
                rowText = rowText .. "[S]"
            else
                rowText = rowText .. " . "
            end
        end
        text = text .. rowText .. "\n"
    end
    local wardText = ""
    for x = 1, 5 do
        if x == v.ward_x then
            wardText = wardText .. "[W]"
        else
            wardText = wardText .. "   "
        end
    end
    v.boardText = text .. wardText
    
    local logStr = ""
    for i = math.max(1, #v.log - 5), #v.log do
        logStr = logStr .. v.log[i] .. "\n"
    end
    v.logText = logStr
end
v.updateDraw = updateDraw
v.updateDraw()
scripts.execute_turn:
local v = ctx.v
if v.lost or v.win then
    ctx.interpreter:queueCommand({cmd="SCENE_EVENT", kind="pop"})
    return
end

table.insert(v.log, "---")

-- Player action
if v.cmdIdx == 1 then
    v.ward_x = math.max(1, v.ward_x - 1)
    table.insert(v.log, "Ward shifted Left.")
elseif v.cmdIdx == 3 then
    v.ward_x = math.min(5, v.ward_x + 1)
    table.insert(v.log, "Ward shifted Right.")
else
    table.insert(v.log, "Ward held position.")
end

-- Bolt move
local nx = v.bolt_x + v.bolt_dx
local ny = v.bolt_y + v.bolt_dy

-- Walls
if nx < 1 then
    nx = 1; v.bolt_dx = -v.bolt_dx
elseif nx > 5 then
    nx = 5; v.bolt_dx = -v.bolt_dx
end

-- Skeletons / Enemy area
if ny >= 3 then
    local hit = false
    if v.skeletons[nx .. "_" .. ny] then
        v.skeletons[nx .. "_" .. ny] = nil
        v.skeletons_left = v.skeletons_left - 1
        table.insert(v.log, "Struck a Skeleton!")
        hit = true
    end
    
    if hit then
        v.bolt_dy = -v.bolt_dy
        ny = v.bolt_y + v.bolt_dy
    elseif ny > 5 then
        ny = 5
        v.bolt_dy = -v.bolt_dy
        table.insert(v.log, "Bounced off back wall.")
    end
end

-- Player area
if ny == 1 then
    if nx == v.ward_x then
        v.bolt_dy = -v.bolt_dy
        ny = v.bolt_y + v.bolt_dy
        table.insert(v.log, "Deflected by Ward!")
    else
        v.hp = v.hp - 1
        table.insert(v.log, "Missed! HP -1")
        if v.hp <= 0 then
            v.lost = true
            table.insert(v.log, "YOU DIED.")
            v.cmdIdx = 1
        else
            nx = 3; ny = 2; v.bolt_dy = 1
        end
    end
end

v.bolt_x = nx
v.bolt_y = ny

if v.skeletons_left <= 0 then
    v.win = true
    table.insert(v.log, "YOU WIN!")
    v.cmdIdx = 1
end

v.updateDraw()
